rationale: PP03 is a row-level position-purity flag. Raw source localizes the flagged Common Stock text to table 10, the non-controlled affiliated investments roll-forward, whose columns include Fair Value at December 31, 2024, Gross Addition, Net Change in Unrealized Appreciation/(Depreciation), and Fair Value at September 30, 2025. Common Stock at table 9 row 4 with fair value shown as zero, so the defect is the retained roll-forward/comparative-style row/identifier, not absence of any source mention of the security.
